claims: "Sky King" refers to a classic 1950s American aviation adventure TV series.
"Sky King" refers to a 2026 Hulu documentary about the 2018 Sea-Tac plane theft by Richard "Beebo" Russell.
The Sky King TV series ran from 1951 to 1962.
Kirby Grant played Sky King.
Gloria Winters played Penny, Sky King's niece.
Sky King was a WWII naval aviator-turned-rancher in Arizona.
Sky King used his airplane, the Songbird, to solve crimes, fight smugglers, and perform rescues.
The Sky King TV series initially featured a Cessna T-50 "Bamboo Bomber".
The Sky King TV series later featured a Cessna 310B.
The documentary "#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" focuses on Richard "Beebo" Russell.
Richard "Beebo" Russell was a 28-year-old ground service agent.
Richard "Beebo" Russell stole a $33 million Bombardier Dash-8 Q400 from Sea-Tac airport on August 10, 2018.
Richard "Beebo" Russell flew for 70 minutes.
Richard "Beebo" Russell performed a barrel roll.
Richard "Beebo" Russell crashed on Ketron Island.
The documentary "#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" premiered on Hulu in April 2026.
The documentary "#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" features air traffic control audio.
The documentary "#SKYKING: Panic in the Sky" features interviews.
The Official Sky King Website provides historical information about the 1950s series.
The Sky King TV series rarely showed the main character killing villains
